Introduction

Ecuador is a country with many languages. Spanish is the most common language, but many communities speak Kichwa and other native languages. These languages are very important because they help people keep their traditions and history alive. Languages are a way to express ideas, feelings and thoughts when people learn about different languages. This diversity makes the country more interesting and helps people understand each other. Respecting all languages is a way to value them.
